title: cerasus lusitanica
intro: Cerasus lusitanica, commonly known as Cherry Plum, is a deciduous shrub or small tree native to Portugal and the Iberian Peninsula. It is valued for its edible fruit and has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Cerasus lusitanica include its ability to support digestive health, reduce stress, and promote a sense of calm. The bioactive constituents of Cerasus lusitanica include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
